title: Where it begins
description: There is a difference between using something and understanding it.

content.text:
For a long time, I’ve been using AI as a tool — running models, writing code, working with libraries, and seeing what they can do.

But somewhere along the way, I started wondering:

What is actually happening inside?

How does a machine turn numbers into meaning?
How does it learn from mistakes?
How does a collection of mathematical operations become something that can recognize patterns, understand language, and generate new things?
I don't want to stay on the surface.

So this is my attempt to go all the way down — from mathematics and basic algorithms to neural networks, transformers, and eventually a model of my own.

I don't know exactly where this path ends.

That's kind of the point.
But I know where it begins.
